title: Exam Technique and Final Review

header.html: All objectives: time plan, command chooser, look-alike terms and decision rules
Apply a repeatable method to every question; choose the right command, block or file; separate look-alike terms across the eight groups
the official Terraform Associate (004) exam content list

toc.title: Five questions to ask in every scenario

html:
1Technique

Item Advice
Time One hour: keep a steady pace and mark hard questions
Read the last line Is it a command, a block, a file or a behavior?
Safe defaults Plan before apply, state is sensitive, never edit state by hand, pin versions
Eliminate Remove answers with the wrong command or the wrong block
Provider details Not tested; ignore cloud-specific names
Never blank Answer every question
Exam tip

. The exam tests what a command or block does and when to use it. Learn each one in a sentence.

2The command chooser

Need Command
Prepare a directory terraform init (-upgrade for newer providers)
Check configuration terraform validate
Fix style terraform fmt
Preview changes terraform plan (-out to save)
Make changes terraform apply
Remove everything terraform destroy
Recreate one resource terraform apply -replace=ADDRESS
Accept real values into state terraform apply -refresh-only
Adopt an existing object import block or terraform import
List or inspect state terraform state list, state show
Forget without destroying removed block with destroy = false or terraform state rm
Rename without recreating moved block
Show outputs terraform output
Test an expression terraform console
Release a stuck lock terraform force-unlock
Authenticate to HCP Terraform terraform login
Debug TF_LOG and TF_LOG_PATH

3Look-alike pairs

Pair Difference
resource and data Manage and read
variable, local, output Input, internal name, result
count and for_each Number and map or set (stable keys)
list, set, map, object Ordered, unique, keys and values, named attributes
Implicit and explicit dependency Reference and depends_on
precondition, postcondition, check, validation Before, after, warning, input
Sensitive, ephemeral, write-only Hidden in output, never saved, accepts ephemeral and is not stored
moved and removed Rename and forget
Local backend and remote backend File on disk and shared, locked storage
CLI workspace and HCP Terraform workspace Another state in one directory and a full environment
Drift and refresh-only Outside change and update state to match
- / + replace orders -/+ destroy first, +/- create first

4Five questions to ask in every scenario

Question Why
Is this about configuration, state or workflow? Finds the objective group
Does the command change infrastructure, state, or neither? plan neither, apply both, -refresh-only state only
Is a secret involved? State and plan files hold it
Is it for one person or a team? Team = remote backend, locking, HCP Terraform
What is the safest, simplest answer? The exam favors built-in features
Exam tip

. If two answers fit, pick the one that does not touch real infrastructure or state unless the question asks for it.

Exam tip

. Read the last line of the question first. It tells you whether the answer is a command, a block, a file or a behavior.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Which command would you run first in a new directory that contains configuration?

  • Aterraform apply
  • Bterraform destroy
  • Cterraform output
  • Dterraform init
Show the answer

Answer: D. terraform init installs providers and modules and prepares the backend.

S2Which block creates several resources from a set of names with stable keys?

  • Acount
  • Bdepends_on
  • Clifecycle
  • Dfor_each
Show the answer

Answer: D. for_each uses map keys or set values, so removing one item does not renumber the others.

S3A secret must never be written to the state. Which approach helps?

  • AMarking the variable sensitive
  • BWriting the secret in a comment
  • CUsing an ephemeral value with a write-only argument
  • DStoring the state in a private repository
Show the answer

Answer: C. Ephemeral values and write-only arguments are not saved in the plan or state.

S4What does terraform plan do to real infrastructure?

  • AIt changes the infrastructure
  • BIt destroys unused resources
  • CIt updates the lock file
  • DIt changes nothing
Show the answer

Answer: D. A plan only shows what would change.

S5A resource was renamed in the configuration and must not be recreated. What should be added?

  • AA removed block
  • BAn import block
  • CA moved block
  • DA check block
Show the answer

Answer: C. A moved block updates the address in the state without recreating the object.

S6Which feature lets several workspaces share the same variables in HCP Terraform?

  • ARun triggers
  • BVariable sets
  • CSentinel policies
  • DPrivate registry modules
Show the answer

Answer: B. Variable sets are reusable groups of variables applied to many workspaces or projects.

5.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the exam?

Show the answer

One hour.

R2Which command prepares the working directory?

Show the answer

terraform init.

R3Which command updates only the state to match reality?

Show the answer

terraform apply -refresh-only.

R4Which block renames without recreating?

Show the answer

moved.

R5Which values are never saved in state?

Show the answer

Ephemeral values.

R6What groups workspaces in HCP Terraform?

Show the answer

A project.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Method group, eliminate, safe defaults, simplest built-in answer
Commands init, validate, fmt, plan, apply, destroy, -replace, -refresh-only, import, state, console, login
Look-alikes resource/data, count/for_each, moved/removed, sensitive/ephemeral/write-only, CLI/HCP workspaces
Defaults plan before apply; protect state; pin versions; remote backend for teams
